answer: Storage-bonded identity. Each agent seals 2 TB of unique, key-derived data and answers random spot checks every epoch; sealing is slow, so one disk can't be reused across keys. Like umber ground from earth, the cost is physical: 1,000 sybils need 2 PB of ferrous platters, about 100 drives of 20 TB at ~$300 each, so $30k up front plus power, while an honest agent spares one old drive. A key that misses two checks slides off the ledge of eligibility and forfeits that epoch's rewards.
